verdict.rationale: Ollama is built to run open models on your own machine. It ships a one-line Linux install script and a public GitHub repo, and serves its HTTP API at localhost:11434. The vendor states that nothing run locally leaves the machine, and community users confirm running it on their own hardware, including ROCm containers on AMD GPUs. Missing for 10: first-party deployment and server-configuration documentation in the pack (one user reports server configs such as mlock are hidden behind defaults), and the larger Cloud-hosted models are not self-hostable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
Ollama is the easiest way to run open AI models locally or in the cloud
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
